# Summary

# Introduction
The Palmer Penguins dataset (Horst et al., 2020) contains body measurements of adult Adélie, Chinstrap and Gentoo penguins (genus *Pygoscelis*) nesting on three islands in Antarctica's Palmer Archipelago: Biscoe, Dream and Torgersen. The data were collected from 2007 to 2009 by Dr. Kristen Gorman and the Palmer Station Antarctica Long Term Ecological Research (LTER) program, as part of a
study of differences between male and female penguins (Gorman et al., 2014).

Every breeding season, researchers identified studies nests where pairs of adults were present prior to egg-laying and consistently monitored these sites. Once a nest was found to have one egg, both adults were captured, measured, and had a blood sample taken to determine each penguin's sex. Consequently, every observation in the data set represents a breeding adult measured at the same point in the nesting cycle.
